description:
A new way to collaborate

Empowering teams by messenger, meetings, calendar, docs, and emails. It's all in one place.
Base
- Use Base AI to quickly build personalized, interactive pages in Base for everything from internal collaboration to external presentations. You can generate a page by directly linking it to an existing table, or simply describe what you need and let AI create the table and build the page for you. The page content automatically syncs with your linked data and adapts perfectly to any screen size.
